book.name: 1 Korin
book.title: 1 KORIN Pol pepa muno namba 1 bogl Korin yomba tongwa

content: Krais endi-prak mina singwa kamo i Pol dipene endungwa
Angrima wagle, okuna na ene meglmara pindre ana God kamo wakai pangwa i dipene ende teingra, ba yomba bitno pai pogl sungwa ka wakai wakai dimere yegl na ta ditendre ene kinano sikrika.
Na nomana yegl pirka na ene meglmara pukamugl moglka enge na ka kanekane tau manedi pirka, ba Yesus Krais pre ya te ye endi-prak mina singwa kamo i keme pirka.
Na ene meglmara wingwa enge yombura dokungo, kundugl pirtre te noko purparaugl diga.
Ana ka diga ya kamambuno wakai dipene ende teinga i yomba bitno pai pogl sungwa ye kanno dimere i na dindre ene kinano sikrika, ba Holi Spirit yombuglomo i ene ombunodi nongugl ende teinga.
Na mambuno yegl erika i ene yomba bitno pai pogl sungwa kanno dingwa i ene pirngino ye mina tenge tekraglkwa, ba God yombuglo i mina ene tenge tenaglmedi na yegl erika.
God Spiritmo nono nomane wakai norkwa

God embriye mambunomo wakai mina yake giglendi kondingwa yomba ye mina no ka ditomga i ye pir-ingwa, ba i makandle ka ta pirkrikwa. Te i makandle sugl yomba kande wau boramunedi erikwa i kanno wakai tamanga.
No God nomane wakai teke pangwa i dipene endumga, kamo i okuna teke paimoglkwa. God dumo makan ere yeikrukwa enge, nomane wakai ka i nono ambuglangesi noragledi uglmange ere endungwa pangwa.
Makandle kaungo yomba ye nomano wakai kamo mambuno i ta pirpogl sikrikwa. Ye i pirpogl sima daglma ana Yaglkande kangiye kande pangwa ye endi-prak mina sikriko.
Ba no ka dumga i pepa mina yegl beglko pangwa:

content.text: i ye ake non-nan ere yeitongwa.”

content: Kamo i okuna teke pangwa, ba no pre ere God ye Spiritmo mina ombunodi norkwa. Te taragl prapra teke paingwa ya te God taraglmo uglmange kaima ere paingwa i Holi Spirit mundu kan-kondungwa.

Yomba ta nomane mina poglodi prukwa i yomba ta sraglmere pirkan erambe? Tamanga. Yomba yene spiritmo suna moglkwa i pirkan orkwa. Ana kuno yegl keunde yomba ta God nomane suna poglodi prukwa i pir kankrikwa, ba God yene Spiritmo pirkan orkwa.
Ana nono makandle spirit i ta ikunga. Tamanga. Nono Spirit yumga, i God mina ungwa. Taragl God yoko norkwa i mambuno pirpogl sinamga pre norkwa.

Ana no taragl yoko imga i mina ka dumga. Ka i makandle yomba nomane wakai pangwa ta beke norokrikwa. Tamanga. Spirit ka i beke norkwa. Te Holi Spirit kaima no mina moglko ana dipoglsi Holi Spirit ye mina moglkwa yomba tomga.

Ba yomba Holi Spirit bogl moglkrambuka, God Spiritmo mina taragl ungwa i ye ta ikrambuka. Sraglpre, ka i prapra kinde dumedi prukwa. Ana ye kamo i mambuno ta pirpogl sikrambuka; sraglpre, taragl i prapra Holi Spirit mina ungwa.
Yomba ta Holi Spirit bogl moglkwa ye taragl i prapra yumbusi mambuno pirkan orkwa. Ba yomba Holi Spirit bogl moglkrambuka ye eremogl yomba Holi Spirit bogl moglkwa mambuno i ta yumbu sikrambuka,

content.text: sindre, ana ye ka yegl beke tenambe?”

content: Ba no we, Krais nomanemo i-wamga.
